card.name: Online, web and streaming as media words
card.fires_on: Words meaning internet delivery, such as streaming, online, web and Internet, placed before a noun like video, journal, edition, site or radio.

modes.description: Streaming, Internet or web describes video, radio or a connection delivering content.
